site: native MLP1 product write excluding Down bias
objective: Mean squared error on training-centered globally RMS-scaled RAW native writes. No task labels or downstream loss supervision.
selection: Fixed final step; no evaluation-based selection or tuning.
architecture: Signed linear encoder, unit-column decoder, learned encoder/decoder biases. ScalarTop32;32disjoint blocks of4 withTop8L2 gates;32fixed shared groups of8 withTop4L2 gates, balanced atom degree2. Exact union; decode shared coordinates once. Common trainable parameter count and initialization. Shared union <=32, so actual active costs reported; not perfectly matched active dimension. No learned gate encoder/membership, hierarchy, Grassmannian constraint or computational DAG.
scope: Tiny reused corpus development pilot. Existing first32documents fit, latter32evaluate; no new reserved BSF/test/task exposure. Models reconstruct already-computed writes, not executable replacements for computing MLP inputs. One training direction only. Fixed minibatch streams shared across kinds perseed. Token/context error decomposition within evaluation is descriptive.
